agent_explanation: Actuated controller truncates NS yellow to 1s instead of required 3s. NS green is gap-terminated at step 324 when NS queue empties (0) while EW (W) has demand (queue 1), so NS yellow starts at 325. It then lasts only one second (325→326 all-red) instead of yellow_seconds=3. With actuated=false the green is not gap-terminated and stays green through step 326, so no short yellow occurs - proving actuation is causal. Extending steps to 329 preserves the same 1s yellow violation, so not an end-of-run artifact.
